data_status: partial — FY2025 Form 17-A annual report not obtained (Definitive Information Statement PDF failed to download from philexmining.com.ph); operating and financial data from 4Q25 press release (24 Feb 2026); Padcal reserves from latest published PMRC-compliant estimate (as of 31 Dec 2023); Silangan reserves/resources from project feasibility disclosures; per-ounce costs not disclosed in press materials

mines.mine_notes: 2025: 6.774 Mt milled (-0.5% YoY); gold output 24,358 oz (-21% YoY on declining grades: gold -17%, copper -7% toward year-end); copper output 18.155M lbs (-8.2% YoY). Realized prices: gold record US$4,338/oz in Q4 2025; copper US$5.24/lb peak, US$4.56/lb average for the year. PMRC-compliant remaining mineable reserves as of 31 Dec 2023: 33.90 Mt at 0.21 g/t Au and 0.17% Cu (~228.9 koz Au, ~57.6 kt Cu); mine life extended to 31 Dec 2028 (from 2027). Cash cost/AISC per ounce not disclosed in press materials. Q1 2026 (post-period): secondary/tertiary crushing plant damage cut throughput 42%; recovery plan targets normalized throughput from May 2026.
mines.processing: Underground block-cave mine (Tuba, Benguet); concentrator producing copper concentrates containing gold plus gold bullion

mines.mine_notes: Held via wholly-owned Silangan Mindanao Mining Co. Inc. (MPSA-149-99-XIII), Surigao del Norte; Boyongan + Bayugo deposits. Boyongan mineable reserve: 81 Mt at 0.67% Cu and 1.12 g/t Au — company-stated recoverable metal 2.81 Moz Au and 992.8 Mlb Cu over 28-year life (phase 1). PMRC MRE at 0.5% CuEq cut-off: Boyongan Measured+Indicated 279 Mt at 0.70 g/t Au, 0.52% Cu (6.27 Moz Au, 3.19B lbs Cu) + Inferred 218 Mt. Feasibility breakeven ~US$2-2.30/lb Cu and ~US$850-900/oz Au (prices assumed Cu US$3.20/lb, Au US$1,342/oz). Phase 1 avg annual output ~81M lbs Cu + 34,000 oz Au; Bayugo = phase 2 (sub-level cave PFS planned). Development in final stretch at end-2025: underground mine and TSF substantially complete, process plant commissioning target end-Jan 2026, first metal pour target end-Q1 2026.
mines.processing: Planned underground (caving) mine; process plant under commissioning at end-2025

notes: Source: Philex 4Q25 press release (via First Pacific, 24 Feb 2026; includes audited FY2025 financials) plus company/project disclosures. FY2025: operating revenue PHP8.854B (+8.2% YoY), core net income PHP1.071B (+43.4%), EBITDA PHP2.517B, net income PHP929.7M (+14.8%). Cash dividend PHP0.04/share declared. First Pacific Group holds ~31.2% economic interest (Two Rivers Pacific Holdings affiliates hold additional 15.0%). Company also holds listed PXP Energy Corp. (upstream oil & gas). Long-term debt PHP17.5B (Silangan funding). Bulawan Mine (Negros Occidental) decommissioned 2002, care & maintenance. Reserve ore tonnages above are company-stated; Padcal Au ounces derived (33.90 Mt × 0.21 g/t).
